discover.title: What bugs you in everyday life?
discover.lead: Suggestions for new apps end up here. Browse, vote – or throw your own idea into the pot.
discover.emptyText: Be the first idea on the board - the others are waiting with their thumbs.
discover.ownIdea: Your own idea - the others vote on this one.

wizard.sendFailed: That didn't work. Your answers are still here – try again in a moment.
wizard.thanksText: Under "My ideas" you'll see whether it gets looked at, planned or built.
wizard.reviewLead: Here are all your answers. Change one with ✏️, then you come back here.

concerns.question: A new app, or one that already exists?
concerns.hint: Wishes for existing apps are welcome too.
nudges: What's missing in an app you already use?
Is there an app that almost fits - but only almost?

problem.question: What problem bugs you?
problem.hint: One or two sentences are enough. No tech speak needed.
problem.placeholder: I keep forgetting whose turn it is to clean the flat…
nudges: What did you do by hand three times this week?
What did you last complain about out loud?
Which pile of notes or spreadsheet is secretly an app?
What do you keep forgetting?
What do you send yourself reminders about in a chat with yourself?

audience.question: Who has this problem?
audience.placeholder: e.g. my flatmates, parents of small kids…
nudges: Think of family, flatmates, your club or colleagues.
Who would you show the app to first?
Who else has this problem – if only they knew it could be solved?

frequency.question: How often does it happen?
nudges: Rare things can be annoying too – tax return, anyone?
Think of last week: how often was it?

helps.question: How would an app help you?
helps.hint: What would it have to do for you to say: finally!
helps.placeholder: It reminds us in turn and shows whose turn it is…
nudges: Imagine the app already exists. What do you tap first?
Should it remind, calculate, collect, share – or something else entirely?
What should it definitely not do?

name.question: Got a name already?
name.hint: A pun, an emoji, a working title – anything goes.
nudges: What would you call the app when telling your friends?
Sometimes an emoji says more than three words.

details.question: Tell us whatever you like
details.hint: Room for everything: wishes, ideas, doubts, wild thoughts.
details.placeholder: Bonus points for whoever takes out the bins voluntarily…
nudges: Is there an app that almost does it? What's missing?
What little extra would make you love it?
What would the perfect Monday morning with the app look like?

visibility.question: Who may see your idea?
visibility.hint: You can change this any time.
nudges: On the board others can vote – that shows me what people want.

board.label: On the board
board.text: Everyone signed in sees the idea and can vote.

private.label: Only for Nico
private.text: Stays between us – nobody else sees it.

anonymous.label: Show anonymously
anonymous.text: Your name isn't shown on the board. Nico still sees it.

mine.title: My ideas
mine.lead_one: One idea so far – a start!
mine.emptyTitle: You haven't submitted an idea yet.
mine.emptyText: Don't worry, "I have this feeling…" counts as a start too.
mine.deleteText: The idea disappears for everyone – from the board and from your list. Nico can still see it, though. If it should be gone completely, tell Nico via Feedback.

admin.title: Admin board
admin.lead_one: One idea in total. Drag cards into another column to change their status.
admin.lead_other: {{count}} ideas in total. Drag cards into another column to change their status.
admin.forbidden: This area is for admins only.
admin.hideHint: The author still sees their idea.
admin.replyPlaceholder: Thanks! Sounds exciting – I'll take a look.
admin.purgeText: The idea is deleted completely – for you too. This can't be undone.

error.notSignedIn: You're not signed in. Reload the page to sign in.

images.title: Sketches or screenshots (optional)
images.hint: Upload an image to imgur.com and paste the link here. Up to 3 images.
images.label: Image link {{n}}
images.invalid: That's not a link to a single imgur image (https://imgur.com/... or https://i.imgur.com/...).

history.title: History
history.lead: Every saved version - compare them and bring an earlier one back.
history.author: Author
history.same: The two versions are the same.
history.restoreText: The idea gets this state again. It is saved as a new version - nothing is lost.

adminEdit.title: Edit idea (admin)
adminEdit.lead: The author sees that an admin changed it, and why.
adminEdit.reason: Why are you changing the idea?
adminEdit.reasonHint: Required - the author sees this sentence.
reasons: Against the rules: ads or spam
Against the rules: malware or phishing

rules.title: Rules
rules.lead: So the idea board stays a good place.
rules.admins: Admins may complete ideas, reword them or remove parts that break these rules. You then see what changed and why - in your idea's history.

items.title: Respect
items.text: No racism, no hate, no incitement and no insults - against anyone.

items.title: Nothing harmful
items.text: No ideas for malware, phishing, fraud, spying on others or anything else illegal.

items.title: No one else's data
items.text: No names, addresses, numbers or photos of other people without their okay.

items.title: No ads
items.text: No spam, no links to shops or your own offers.

items.title: One idea per entry
items.text: Several ideas? Better several entries - so people can vote for each.

quick.title: What came to mind?
quick.placeholder: Jot it down - you can work it out later.
quick.adminsOnly: The quick note is the admins' notebook. Submit your idea here:
